candidate_orders.rationale: law_practice.json's held-as-prose default, which every one of its templates is measured against: 'the CLIENT only where the corpus genuinely spans more than one AND the user has explicitly approved a client-named branch, then the MATTER, then the DOCUMENT FUNCTION, then the period last.' Function follows the matter for 00's own reason - 'A work type such as Homework 3 is meaningful only after the course is known' - because an amendment, a schedule or a supplemental list is meaningless without the matter it belongs to. The period is last and never first: 'For document and record domains, project, function, or subject usually comes before time because putting year first scatters related work across calendar folders', and the anchor adds that no sibling may claim otherwise, since nothing in this world is capture-based. The client level is absent rather than optional; see the validation constraints.

dimensions.retrieval_rationale: The matter is the one thing every artefact in a practitioner file agrees on, and it is the parent that makes a document function intelligible.

What the document does is the leaf a practitioner searches for once the matter is fixed; law_practice.motions-and-briefs records that its whole situation is one value at this level rather than a level of its own.
The period separates recurring cycles inside one long matter and is the only level several rows drop outright, so it is offered last and never required.

validation_constraints: client is NOT a role of this definition, and its absence is the family's own ruling rather than an oversight: law_practice.json seeds the client level ineligible because 'in a single-client corpus it is "use an author or organization merely as a collector" and would "create meaningless one-child levels", and in any corpus it is a disclosure', and no record shape here can express 'ineligible until the user explicitly approves it'. A bound optional role is an OFFERED level, so binding client would ship the disclosure by default. client stays a declared, searchable fact on law_practice and is never a folder level.

a NAMED THIRD PARTY may never become a level under any of this recipe's roles - 'an adverse party, a witness, a deponent, an accused, a complainant, a child - may NEVER be a folder level, however strong the grouping axis, because a path writes their identity into the filesystem where every later process reads it'

scope_period may never be promoted above subject_anchor: 00 reserves time-primacy for capture-based media and law_practice.json forbids a sibling claiming it - '`time_first: true` in this family would be claiming the photos exception without the photos evidence'

the levels several rows want above the matter - the proceeding tier, the parcel, the corporate entity, the sitting, the diligence chapter, the submission reference - have no declared key on law_practice, and this definition proposes none of them; each is recorded as an exclusion on the row that wanted it
definitions.sole_order_attestation: law_practice's 28 kept template rows attest exactly one nesting of these three roles. Every departure the corpus records SUBTRACTS a level or asks for a level that has no declared key; not one reverses a pair. law_practice.closing-binder drops the period ('a period level here is exactly the fault 00 names for generated templates - it would "create meaningless one-child levels"'), law_practice.estates-administration drops the client and the period, law_practice.time-and-billing drops the matter for its firm-wide export, and law_practice.corporate-secretarial, .conveyancing, .hearing-transcripts, .due-diligence, .transactional-deal, .contract-negotiation and .regulatory-submission each ask for a top level this schema declares no key for. The one reversal a second order would plausibly offer is period-first, and the schema anchor forbids it by name: 'NOT TIME-FIRST, and no sibling may claim otherwise.' A second order authored here would therefore be an invented alternative shown beside a real one, which is worse than an absent one because the user cannot tell which is which.

candidate_orders.rationale: One level, deliberately, for the six law_practice situations whose own recommendation is that nothing below the matter may become a branch. law_practice.trial-preparation states the rule: 'A COMPILATION MUST NOT BE EXPLODED INTO FOLDER LEVELS AT ALL... those are the bundle's SECTIONS and turning them into folders dissolves the only object that exists.' law_practice.closing-binder reaches it from the other side - a closing index 'is a negotiated running order' and 'imposing a function taxonomy over a set that arrives with its own agreed order destroys the one thing every party to the deal can navigate' - which is the same answer 00 gives an existing folder: 'Existing folders must not be automatically flattened, renamed, or reorganized simply because a template would produce a different structure.'

dimensions.retrieval_rationale: The matter, transaction or case package is the only level these situations accept; their members are held together as files beneath it rather than sorted into branches that would separate each item from the thing that makes it intelligible.

validation_constraints: a document-function level is deliberately absent here and is not an omission: law_practice.court-filing-record records that 'Every member of this situation has the same function - it is a receipt - so a function level would be exactly the "meaningless one-child levels" 00 warns against', and law_practice.evidence-exhibits that 'the exhibit set should stay a FLAT set beneath it, ordered by nothing'

no level may be named from an identifier that resolves to a party through one public search - the exhibit designator, the production control number, the regulatory submission reference and the data-room folder tree are each excluded on the row that named them
client is not a role here for the same reason it is not a role on def.matter-file

candidate_orders.rationale: The shape law_practice's three register-like situations reach when the matter level is unavailable to them. law_practice.conflicts-check: 'FUNCTION FIRST - the screening record as a standalone register-shaped administrative area rather than a per-client tree - then PERIOD.' law_practice.time-and-billing: 'for a MATTER-PLURAL artefact the matter level drops out entirely and what remains is function then PERIOD, with period doing the work the matter cannot.' law_practice.corporate-secretarial: 'Period comes LAST but is genuinely load-bearing here, unlike in the schema default, because the world is anniversary-cyclical.'

dimensions.retrieval_rationale: The register's own function has to come first because a bare year folder of screening or billing documents is unintelligible - 00's rule that a work type 'is meaningful only after the course is known', read across.

These are the three situations whose material is genuinely cyclical: a screening register is chronological, a bill covers a period, and corporate secretarial work repeats the same four functions every anniversary year.

validation_constraints: the matter level is absent by argument rather than by contract: law_practice.corporate-secretarial records that a matter level under a perpetual retainer 'would hold one child forever', and law_practice.time-and-billing that for a firm-wide export the matter 'is not merely disclosive here, it is INAPPLICABLE to the container - filing it under any one matter would be false'

this is the closest anything in law_practice comes to a period-led tree and it is still not time-first: 'the period rises only because the project level is absent, not because this world is capture-based'
a payee, a searched counterparty, a screened colleague or a natural person named in a register may never become a level
definitions.sole_order_attestation: The three law_practice rows that reach this shape record the same nesting and the reversal is refused in writing by two of them. law_practice.conflicts-check: 'This is the closest any row in this family comes to earning a time level, and it still does not earn `time_first`: the function level must come first because a bare year folder of screening documents is unintelligible.' law_practice.time-and-billing: 'the schema's prohibition on siblings claiming time-first is respected in letter and in substance.' A period-first alternative is the only second order the corpus suggests, and the corpus is what rules it out.

candidate_orders.rationale: law_practice.precedent-bank is the one row in the family whose first two levels are not disclosure-restricted but STRUCTURALLY ABSENT: 'this row's material has no client and no matter to disclose, so the disclosure objection that seeds the client level ineligible everywhere else is silent here... the recommendation begins at DOCUMENT OR INSTRUMENT FUNCTION (what the model document is for), and then version lineage sits BELOW it rather than as a level, because versions of one precedent are a version family and not a folder generation.'

dimensions.retrieval_rationale: What the model document is FOR is the only thing on the bytes to branch on, and it is the word a practitioner uses to go and find one.

validation_constraints: the practice or department name must not become the top level by default: that would 'use an author or organization merely as a collector' and in a single-practice corpus would 'create meaningless one-child levels'
version lineage is a version family and never a level - 00 already collects duplicate and version-family signals universally without needing a branch

candidate_orders.rationale: creative.json's held-as-prose default verbatim, which the 41 creative.* siblings are measured against: 'client only where the corpus genuinely serves more than one client (otherwise it is the collector level 00's own validator rejects), then project, then stage, then artifact_type as the optional deepest level.' The parent-context test fixes it - 'a parent dimension should provide the context required to understand the child. A work type such as Homework 3 is meaningful only after the course is known' - and 'Round 2' or '_v3' is meaningless without the work, exactly as Homework 3 is meaningless without the course. Not time-first: the anchor grants the capture exception to creative.shoot-day-media and creative.raw-photo-catalogue by name and to nobody else.

dimensions.retrieval_rationale: Only where the corpus genuinely serves more than one commissioner; in a single-client or in-house corpus this level must flatten because it would be a one-child collector.
The work is the parent that makes every file under it intelligible, and it is the level a maker names out loud.
Where the work had got to is what separates two otherwise identical files of one job, and it is unfilled for material that never moved through review.
The kind of file is the optional deepest level; the anchor makes it optional because many creative corpora are better flat at this depth.

candidate_orders.rationale: Three creative rows argue independently that stage is the weak level and must not stand between the work and the kind of file. creative.printmaking-editions: 'An edition does not move through stages; it passes through ONE-WAY TERMINAL EVENTS... A `stage` level here would open branches that are empty for the whole life of the material and then permanently empty afterwards' - its recommendation is 'project then artifact_type, with NO stage level'. creative.short-form-writing: 'The state that actually matters here repeats per destination, so a stage level would collapse one piece's AGNI rejection and its Ploughshares acceptance into a single folder named "submitted". The recommendation is therefore the piece, then artifact_type.' creative.ad-campaign: 'a route that survives selection carries files at every stage at once while a route that was killed carries only early ones, so a stage level scatters one idea across three branches', with stage 'demoted to an optional leaf rather than a standing level'. This order is argued from those three corpora and is not an authored alternative.

dimensions.retrieval_rationale: Unchanged from the default: only where the corpus genuinely serves more than one commissioner.
The work stays the parent under either order; that is the one thing every creative row agrees on.
Where the material passes through terminal events rather than stages, the kind of file is what actually varies under the work.
Demoted to a leaf, which is what creative.ad-campaign asks for and what an edition or a repeatedly-submitted piece needs.

validation_constraints: client_org may never bind a counterparty in a SUBMITTED-TO role: creative.submission-query records that 'Recording a market as `client` would assert a paid relationship that does not exist and would fuse forty rejections with one job', and 00 requires that 'The system must separate roles that happen to contain the same entity type'

the maker is never a level: creative.self-initiated-work records that an author-named branch is one 00 'refuses in advance - a template must not "create meaningless one-child levels" and must not "use an author or organization merely as a collector"'

no level may be derived from a medium, format, channel, locale, software, engine target or screen: each is a value, and 'A folder level for medium or format would scatter one named work across Posters, PDFs, PNGs and Source Files'

this recipe may not be applied to capture-led material: creative.json grants the time-first exception to creative.shoot-day-media and creative.raw-photo-catalogue by name, and both are refused a template in this wave rather than filed project-first

candidate_orders.rationale: creative.exhibition's NJ-EXH-3, answered. The row states the recommendation as '`project` (the show) first, then `stage`, then `artifact_type`' and then records that touring breaks it: 'One show at three venues has one stable checklist and three sets of plans, texts, schedules and documentation.' Its three alternatives are '(a) show first with venue as a leaf under `stage` - lossy but harmless; (b) show first with `venue` as a genuine second level, which requires the creative schema to adopt `venue` alongside its four candidates; (c) venue first, which scatters one show across institutions and is the exhibition analogue of the year-first mistake 00 warns about', and it says 'Recommendation offered, not taken: (b).' 60 section 5 adopts `venue` on creative, which is the condition (b) named, so (b) is what this recipe builds. The stage level is a CUSTODY sequence here rather than a maturity sequence - 'pre-install, install, run, deinstall and tour' - which is what makes a condition report dated after the close intelligible.

dimensions.retrieval_rationale: The show is the parent: 'a file named `Condition report - cat 14 - incoming.pdf` is meaningless without the show', exactly as Homework 3 is meaningless without the course.
The venue is a genuine second level only for a touring show; a single-venue exhibition leaves it unbound rather than producing a one-child level.
Pre-install, install, run, deinstall and tour is a custody sequence, and it is what separates the same document class before and after the hang.
Checklist, hang plan, loan agreement, condition report and wall text are the leaf a registrar searches for once the show and the leg are fixed.

validation_constraints: the lender or courtesy line may never become a level: NJ-EXH-1 records that there is no canonical key for it, that '`client` is wrong (a lender does not commission), `venue` is wrong (a lender does not host)', and that 'a folder named for a private collector publishes exactly the identity the courtesy line was written to protect'. NO FIELD IS PROPOSED.
client is not a role here: 'an exhibiting institution is not a commissioning counterparty - it shows work it did not order'
this recipe never claims the works on the checklist: 'The artwork files and the exhibition files are different objects', and the making record of any listed work belongs to its own creative row
definitions.sole_order_attestation: creative.exhibition is the only corpus behind this recipe and it enumerates its own alternatives, rejecting the one that would be a second nesting: '(c) venue first, which scatters one show across institutions and is the exhibition analogue of the year-first mistake 00 warns about.' Alternative (a) is a leaf PLACEMENT for the venue rather than a different ordering of these roles, so it is not a candidate order either. One nesting is attested and a second would have to be invented against the row's own words.
